_readme: Add your gigs to the list below. Each one needs a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a venue; town, time and ticketUrl are optional. Every gig should also get its own page on the site, with infoUrl pointing at it - see Adding a gig in the README. If the start time is not settled yet you can write TBC, but you can also just leave it out - a gig with no time shows as TBC on its own. A gig disappears from the site four hours after it starts - so an 8pm is gone by midnight - and a gig whose time still says TBC holds its place all day and goes at 4am. Nothing is deleted; it only stops being listed. The list sorts itself soonest-first, so you can just add to the bottom.

_example.time: 9pm - or TBC if it is not settled yet
_example.note: optional - a line about what makes the night different
_example.infoUrl: optional - a page on this site with the full details; wins over ticketUrl
_example.durationHours: optional - how long the gig runs. Used for the entry someone gets when they tap Add to calendar (defaults to 3), and it also keeps the gig listed for longer than the usual four hours if you are playing an all-dayer.
